# SortableJS

`sortable-1.15.7.min.js` is the unmodified SortableJS 1.15.7 browser distribution,
copied from the locally reviewed [SortableJS source](https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable)
at commit `48b626bbc61afbb0f179730c1dd3cca3dcc8b788`.

It supplies drag handles, touch sorting and automatic scrolling for the private
property editor. It is loaded locally, only by `admin.js`; no CDN or build step is
required. The MIT license is in `Sortable-LICENSE.txt`.
